decisions.name: 南方航空
reasoning: Broad hubs exposed a two-sided macro shock: oil collapsed while RMB weakness created very large FX losses.
The 2015 annual report showed real recurring conversion rather than a thematic story: fuel cost fell 30.36%, attributable profit rose 117.2%, and operating cash flow rose 70.1%.
The same report also quantified the offset: FX loss reached RMB5.702bn, so the thesis explicitly includes both drivers rather than treating low oil as a one-factor positive.
Price absorption was low: 20/60/120d excess versus CSI300 about -3.5/-11.9/-15.6pp.
This is a cyclical operating improvement with a material offsetting macro risk, so it remains Research only.

decisions.name: 光线传媒
reasoning: The Mermaid was unquestionably company-material in headline scale: 6.5-day box office exceeded 50% of the company's most recent audited annual revenue.
But box office is not company profit: investment share, final settlement and profit-sharing economics were not sufficiently disclosed at the cutoff.
The event is a single blockbuster rather than recurring operating conversion; repeatability and cash economics were unresolved.
Price was not crowded—20/60d excess was about -5.9/-5.1pp—so rejection is specifically a profit-pool-quality decision rather than a price-absorption decision.
decisions.reconsiderationTrigger: Reported company earnings/cash conversion from the film, available only after the holdout cutoff, may be used in post-outcome diagnosis but not to change this decision.

decisions.name: 万达院线
reasoning: Jan-Feb box-office revenue +69.6% and viewers +81.2% gave unusually clean recurring operating conversion.
However the stock had been suspended from 2016-02-24 for a planned acquisition/restructuring and was not executable when the confirming February operating brief was published.
A high-quality economic thesis cannot count as an opportunity if the listed expression cannot be traded.
Lower down payments and rising home prices were real broad-hub changes.

Within the Q1 cutoff, the run did not establish a sufficiently clean company-specific recurring earnings/cash conversion without using already-contaminated prior project motifs or later-quarter results.
Iron ore's record 19% one-day jump was a powerful expectations reset, but the following day major banks/miners already questioned its durability.
No clean A-share company-level Q1 earnings conversion was frozen that justified chasing the commodity repricing.
The parent-level Syngenta acquisition was strategically large but did not create a direct, contemporaneous earnings or asset-injection bridge to an A-share listed subsidiary within the holdout.
Baidu's autonomous-driving push was strategically interesting, but the run did not establish a listed A-share supplier with reported customer/order conversion before Q1 end.
The most direct listed-company expression with quantified economics was already captured in the airline case; no additional clean asymmetric company bridge was frozen.

funnel.interpretation: In this holdout the main frequency bottleneck is company-level evidence/expression mapping, not the number of hub events.
